title: Financial Counseling Desk Reference: Patient Payment Plans Enrollment Channels and Proposal Validity
content:
For each tier of the Patient Payment Plans, the desk applies the following figures on how a proposal is prepared and how long it stays open for the patient's signature.

| Tier | Patient may set the plan up in the MyLinden portal without a counselor | Financial counselor must review the proposal before it is offered | Counselor review time (business days) | Proposal validity (calendar days after the proposal date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3-Month Interest-Free Plan | Yes | No | 0 | 14 |
| 6-Month Interest-Free Plan | Yes | No | 0 | 14 |
| 12-Month Interest-Free Plan | Yes | No | 0 | 14 |
| 18-Month Extended Plan | No | Yes | 3 | 14 |
| 24-Month Extended Plan | No | Yes | 3 | 14 |
| Financial Hardship Plan | No | Yes | 5 | 14 |

**Terms used in the table.**

- *Counselor review time* is the number of business days for the counselor review; 0 means the tier has no review.
- *Proposal validity* is the number of calendar days after the proposal date within which the patient must sign.

**Points the table settles.**

- The three Interest-Free tiers may be set up by the patient in the portal and carry no counselor review; each shows a review time of 0.
- The 18-Month Extended Plan and the 24-Month Extended Plan are prepared through a financial counselor, whose review takes 3 business days; the Financial Hardship Plan is prepared through a counselor whose review takes 5 business days.
- The proposal validity is the same 14 calendar days on every tier.
